name: Omni Engine broad web query coverage benchmark
description: A broad, curated offline evaluation suite spanning common search intents and technical/general domains. It is not literally every possible internet query; the web query space is unbounded. Domain judgments are intentionally non-exhaustive and are used for ranking-density evaluation. Add graded relevanceByUrl judgments for rigorous recall/nDCG.
